answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments on three mainstream LLM tasks: instruction-following, mathematical reasoning, and code-generating.

answer_2.quote: We employ AlpacaEval to evaluate models fine-tuned on Stanford Alpaca dataset, using win-rate as the evaluation metric and GPT-4 as the annotator. We employ HumanEval to evaluate models fine-tuned on Evolinstruction-66k dataset, using pass@1 as the evaluation metric. For the SQuAD dataset, Exact Match (EM) is utilized as the evaluation metric. Accuracy (acc) is used as the evaluation metric for all other tasks.
